menu_items.name: Mango & Avocado Carpaccio
menu_items.description: Delicately sliced ripe Hass avocado and sweet yellow mango arranged in an elegant rosette fan, garnished with whipped goat cheese rosettes, fresh garden basil, and cracked black pepper.

menu_items.name: Roasted Pumpkin & Ginger Velouté
menu_items.description: Velvety roasted Musanze pumpkin soup infused with fresh ginger root, lemongrass, coconut cream swirl, and spiced pepitas.

menu_items.name: Warm Goat Cheese & Fig Bruschetta
menu_items.description: Artisanal sourdough crostini layered with warm goat cheese, fig reduction, crushed walnuts, and fresh thyme from Kigali gardens.

menu_items.name: Confit Byaldi (Layered Ratatouille)
menu_items.description: Artfully spiraled medallions of golden squash, green zucchini, Japanese eggplant, and ripe vine tomatoes slow-baked over charred bell pepper and herb de Provence piperade coulis.

menu_items.name: Crispy Lake Kivu Sambaza
menu_items.description: Golden crispy miniature Lake Kivu silver fish dusted in smoked paprika and sea salt, served with house-whipped dill tartare and charred lemon wedges.

menu_items.name: Rwandan Akabenz Pork Crostini
menu_items.description: Succulent pan-crisped pork belly bites glazed in local spiced honey and akabanga chili reduction, served over grilled sourdough crostini with pickled red onions.

menu_items.name: Truffle Mushroom & Plantain Croquettes
menu_items.description: Crispy golden mashed sweet plantain and wild forest mushroom croquettes filled with melted gruyère cheese, served with garlic herb aioli.

menu_items.name: Kigali Garden Green Salad
menu_items.description: Crisp organic hydroponic greens, avocado ribbons, cherry tomatoes, toasted pumpkin seeds, and fresh passion fruit vinaigrette.

menu_items.name: Spiced Gourmet Beef Samosas
menu_items.description: Crispy handmade golden pastry parcels stuffed with aromatic spiced minced beef, spring onions, and coriander, served with sweet tamarind chutney.

menu_items.name: Grilled Nile Perch with Lemon Butter
menu_items.description: Fresh Lake Victoria perch fillet pan-seared with herb-infused lemon butter sauce, served on a bed of sautéed greens and roasted baby potatoes.

menu_items.name: Moroccan Braised Lamb Tagine
menu_items.description: Slow-braised tender lamb shank with sweet apricots, toasted almonds, aromatic saffron-cinnamon broth, served with steamed couscous.

menu_items.name: Wild Forest Mushroom Risotto
menu_items.description: Creamy carnaroli rice simmered in rich vegetable reduction with wild forest mushrooms, Parmigiano-Reggiano, and white truffle oil drizzle.

menu_items.name: Boho Buddha Quinoa Bowl
menu_items.description: Organic Rwandan quinoa, grilled zucchini ribbons, spiced chickpeas, creamy avocado fan, and tahini-maple drizzle.

menu_items.name: Prime Grilled Ribeye Steak
menu_items.description: 350g char-grilled aged prime beef ribeye steak cooked to perfection, served with crispy roasted hasselback potato, butter-glazed asparagus, and rich red wine jus.

menu_items.name: Crispy Chicken Schnitzel Fettuccine
menu_items.description: Golden panko-crusted chicken cutlet served atop handmade ribbon fettuccine in a velvety garlic-Parmigiano cream sauce, with roasted cherry tomatoes and crispy sage.

menu_items.name: Eko Signature Nyama Choma Platter
menu_items.description: Slow-smoked marinated goat skewers & prime beef cuts with roasted sweet plantains (aloco), fresh kachumbari salad, and fiery pili-pili dip.

menu_items.name: Grilled Jumbo King Prawns
menu_items.description: Flame-grilled jumbo prawns basted with roasted garlic herb butter, saffron jasmine rice, and charred lemon.

menu_items.name: Pan-Roasted Herb Chicken Supreme
menu_items.description: Free-range chicken breast with wild thyme jus, velvety potato mousseline, and butter-glazed baby carrots.

menu_items.name: Handcrafted Truffle Tagliatelle
menu_items.description: Fresh artisanal egg pasta tossed in black truffle cream, aged parmesan shavings, and cracked black pepper.

menu_items.name: Rwandan Passion Fruit Cheesecake
menu_items.description: Velvety baked New York style cheesecake crowned with tart Rwandan passion fruit coulis on a buttery speculoos crust.

menu_items.name: Valrhona Warm Chocolate Lava Cake
menu_items.description: Warm Valrhona dark chocolate cake with a molten truffle center, accompanied by house-made bourbon vanilla bean gelato.

menu_items.name: Exotic Mango & Papaya Fruit Tart
menu_items.description: Crisp almond sablé pastry shell filled with silky vanilla diplomat cream, topped with fresh seasonal tropical fruits.

menu_items.name: Bourbon Vanilla Bean Crème Brûlée
menu_items.description: Classic French custard infused with Bourbon vanilla, finished with a caramelized brittle sugar crust and fresh berries.

menu_items.name: Lake Kivu Artisanal Honey Cake
menu_items.description: Multi-layered delicate sponge cake infused with raw Rwandan forest honey and whipped sweet sour cream frosting.

menu_items.name: Artisanal Tropical Sorbet Trio
menu_items.description: Refreshing trio of house-churned passionfruit, mango-lime, and hibiscus flower sorbets with fresh garden mint.

menu_items.name: Kigali Sunset Spritz
menu_items.description: Craft cocktail featuring artisanal Aperol, prosecco, fresh passion fruit nectar, and sparkling botanical soda.

menu_items.name: Golden Smoked Bourbon
menu_items.description: Premium bourbon, Angostura bitters, raw demerara syrup, smoked with cedar wood and garnished with edible gold leaf.

menu_items.name: Pornstar Martini & Prosecco
menu_items.description: Exquisite cocktail blending premium vanilla vodka, Passoã passion fruit liqueur, fresh passion fruit puree, and lime, served with a chilled shot of sparkling Prosecco.

menu_items.name: Pink Gin & Tonic Spritz
menu_items.description: Vibrant pink botanical gin infused with wild berries and hibiscus, paired with artisanal Indian tonic, fresh pink grapefruit wheel, and crushed crystal ice.

menu_items.name: Golden Goss Cocktail
menu_items.description: Artisanal golden cocktail with subtle amber botanicals, dried citrus, and delicate honeyed warmth.

menu_items.name: Pornstar Martini
menu_items.description: Exquisite cocktail blending premium vanilla vodka, Passoã passion fruit liqueur, fresh passion fruit puree, and lime, served with a chilled shot of sparkling Prosecco.

menu_items.name: Fresh Hibiscus Iced Tea
menu_items.description: Handcrafted infusion of organic hibiscus petals, wild mint, crushed ginger, and pure Rwandan raw honey over crystal ice.

menu_items.name: Garden Basil & Lime Mocktail
menu_items.description: Signature mocktail with muddled garden basil, cold-pressed lime juice, crushed cucumber, and sparkling ginger beer.

menu_items.name: Bordeaux Grand Réserve Glass
menu_items.description: Deep ruby French red blend with opulent aromas of blackcurrant, dark chocolate, and French oak.

menu_items.name: Marlborough Sauvignon Blanc Glass
menu_items.description: Crisp, vibrant white wine with bright citrus blossom, passion fruit notes, and a refreshing mineral finish.

menu_items.name: Rwandan Red Bourbon Espresso
menu_items.description: Double shot of high-altitude Lake Kivu Red Bourbon Arabica espresso, featuring rich golden crema, bright citrus blossom undertones, and a velvety dark cocoa finish.

menu_items.name: Artisanal Cinnamon Cappuccino
menu_items.description: Double shot of Rwandan specialty espresso topped with micro-foamed organic whole milk, handcrafted rosette latte art, and dusted with freshly ground Rwandan hill cinnamon.

menu_items.name: Iced Nyungwe Vanilla Latte
menu_items.description: Chilled double-extracted Rwandan Arabica espresso swirled through cold fresh creamy milk and pure Madagascar-Nyungwe vanilla syrup over crystal ice rocks.
